module_summary: ratls.c is the portable mbedTLS client (one TLS session plus an HTTP GET; raTlsRequest for RA lookups, raTlsDownload as the streamed updater download) built only by the RA and updater overlays; selfupdate.c is the updater's pure parsing half (SHA256SUMS, version revision, GitHub redirect allow-list, ELF header check). sysdisc.cpp boots the physical disc (SYSTEM.CNF BOOT2 parse, disc-key fallback, bounded DETCT/NODISC waits). sysneutrino.cpp maps OPL devices to Neutrino's -bsd backends, runs the pre-teardown preflights (DVR files, bd device number, udpfs ip= toml sync, SMB/NFS toml rewrite), writes the cheats and RA handoff configs, and composes and budgets the ExecPS2 argv for the keep-IOP handoff. system.h declares the system layer split across system.cpp, sysdisc.cpp, sysneutrino.cpp and sysvmc.cpp.

findings.title: system.cpp include prelude and disc-probe constants copied verbatim into sysneutrino.cpp, sysvmc.cpp and sysdisc.cpp at the split
findings.problem: When system.cpp was split, its whole prelude (DECI2 include, delaythread/time, the SYS_DISC_* constexprs and their 6-line comment, ~25 project headers, PADEMU libds34, fileXio/usbhdfsd-common/ps2sdkapi_compat 'VMC contiguity probe') was pasted into each new file. SYS_DISC_DETECT/REDETECT/NODISC_MS are used only in sysdisc.cpp:161,185,186; the copies at sysneutrino.cpp:15-23, sysvmc.cpp:15-23 and system.cpp:17-25 are dead. sysneutrino.cpp uses no DelayThread, clock, fileXio, USBMASS ioctl, ps2sdk_get_iop_fd, ds34, cheat, xparam, pggsm, OSDHistory, ioprp or extern_irx symbol; sysdisc.cpp likewise uses none of the VMC/PADEMU/fileXio/RA headers.
findings.fix: Delete the SYS_DISC_* constants and their comment from sysneutrino.cpp, sysvmc.cpp and system.cpp (keep sysdisc.cpp's). Delete delaythread/time from sysneutrino.cpp and sysvmc.cpp, and trim each split file's include list to the headers it uses (for sysneutrino.cpp at least lines 7-23, 57-65, 39, 42, 44, 48, 50-55; for sysdisc.cpp at least 9-11, 39-52 except mmcesupport, 53-66), letting the compiler confirm the minimal set.
findings.benefit: About 70 source lines and the misleading 'disc wait' / 'VMC contiguity probe' comments in files that do neither; no ELF change (constexpr ints and unused headers emit nothing), faster compiles (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read all four preludes; they match line for line (dupes-blocks.tsv agrees). Grep SYS_DISC_(DETECT|REDETECT|NODISC)_MS over *.c,*.cpp,*.h: definitions in system.cpp, sysvmc.cpp, sysneutrino.cpp, sysdisc.cpp; uses only sysdisc.cpp:161,185,186 (and a system.h:24 comment). Grep DelayThread|clock( in system.cpp/sysvmc.cpp/sysneutrino.cpp: only system.cpp:504 uses DelayThread. Grep in sysneutrino.cpp for fileXio|USBMASS_|ps2sdk_get_iop_fd|ds34|cheat|xparam|pggsm|OSD|ioprp|_irx: only the include lines and comments. INFERRED part: the exact minimal project-header set, which needs a compile.

findings.title: sysneutrino.cpp: file read, write-with-restore and two 8 KB static buffer pairs duplicated in the udpfs ip sync and SMB/NFS preflight
findings.problem: sysSyncNeutrinoUdpfsToml and sysNeutrinoSmbPreflight each carry the same accumulate-read loop (403-409 vs 670-676) and the same O_TRUNC write plus restore-original-on-short-write block (446-465 vs 733-749), and each owns static toml[4096] plus updated[4116] / updated[4608]. Both run only on the GUI thread before teardown and never nest, so the second pair of buffers is never live at the same time as the first. sysWriteNeutrinoCheats (980-991) repeats the open/write/close/unlink-on-short-write that sysNeutrinoRAWrite (1068-1079) already implements.
findings.fix: Move the two buffers to file scope once (toml[4096], updated[4608]) and use them from both functions; replace the duplicated read loop and write-restore block with two small static helpers (read whole file into toml, write updated or restore toml). Take sysNeutrinoRAWrite out of the RETROACHIEVEMENTS block and call it from sysWriteNeutrinoCheats.
findings.justification: The helpers replace two copies each of the same 7-line read loop and 15-line write/restore block plus one 10-line write/unlink copy, so code shrinks, and sharing the buffers removes a whole duplicate 8 KB .bss pair.
findings.benefit: 8,212 B .bss (INFERRED: 4096+4116+4096+4608 = 16,916 B now vs 4096+4608 = 8,704 B shared) and about 25 lines.
findings.evidence: Read sysneutrino.cpp:382-468 and 637-752 side by side: the read loops and write/restore blocks differ only in log text and return codes. Callers: sysSyncNeutrinoUdpfsToml only from sysNeutrinoPreflight (sysneutrino.cpp:837, udpfs/udpfsbd/udpbd only); sysNeutrinoSmbPreflight from ethsupport (system.h:79 contract, smb/nfs leg) - disjoint devices, both pre-teardown, neither calls the other. sysNeutrinoRAWrite at 1068-1079 under #ifdef RETROACHIEVEMENTS (1021-1124).

findings.title: Three hand-written copies of the Neutrino argument token walk (neutrinoArgHasActiveFlag, neutrinoEffectiveBsdfs, neutrinoArgActiveValue)
findings.problem: Each function re-implements the same skip-blanks / find-token-end / stop-at --b walk over gNeutrinoArgs and extraArgs. neutrinoEffectiveBsdfs (234-254) is exactly neutrinoArgActiveValue(extraArgs, "-bsdfs=", ...) followed by a name lookup: both scan global then per-game args, require a non-empty value, and let the last token win.
findings.fix: Move neutrinoArgActiveValue above neutrinoEffectiveBsdfs and replace the 21-line loop in neutrinoEffectiveBsdfs with one call into a 16-byte buffer plus the names[] comparison.
findings.benefit: About 15 lines and one fewer copy of tokenizer rules that must agree with Neutrino's parser; a few hundred bytes of .text at most (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read 199-261 and 881-904. Both loops: sources {gNeutrinoArgs, extraArgs}, skip ' '/'\t', end at blank, break on a 3-char --b, match prefix with len > prefix length, overwrite on each later match. A $-disabled token does not start with '-bsdfs=' in either, so behaviour is unchanged; values longer than 15 chars cannot truncate to a 2-5 char name.

findings.title: sysLastPathSeparator is a byte-identical copy of supportbase.cpp's sbLastPathSeparator
findings.problem: The 13-line static helper exists twice with only the name changed, and util.cpp:288-292 open-codes the same last-of-slash-or-backslash logic inline.
findings.fix: Keep one non-static copy (for example in util.cpp with a prototype in util.h), delete the other, and use it at util.cpp:288-292.
findings.justification: Adding one prototype lets a 13-line duplicate and a 4-line inline copy go, a net reduction.
findings.benefit: About 15 lines; tens of bytes of .text (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read sysneutrino.cpp:279-291 and supportbase.cpp:1955-1967: identical bodies. Grep strrchr(..., '\\') over src/: util.cpp:289 (same logic inline, 288-292), saveicon.cpp:867 and others with different shapes not counted.

findings.title: Bounds guards that can never fail in convertCompatmaskToModes and the core-argument appends of sysRunNeutrinoLaunch
findings.problem: result[COMPAT_MODE_COUNT + 2] is 10 bytes (COMPAT_MODE_COUNT is 8, iosupport.h:106) and at most 5 digits are appended, so all five pos guards are always true. argv has 32 slots and at most 13 core entries are appended before appendArgTokens (argv0, bsd, bsdfs, dvd, -qb, -gc, -dbc, -logo, -gsm, -elf, two -mc, -cwd), so every argc < argvMax test before line 1370 is always true; the real limit is the 14-entry/256-byte check at 1401-1412.
findings.fix: Drop the pos guards and the 'bounds-guarded so widening the set later cannot overflow' comment; drop the argc < argvMax tests on the core appends before appendArgTokens (keep the ones after it at 1375, 1382, 1389, which can trigger).
findings.benefit: About 10 lines and simpler conditions; no measurable ELF change (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: COMPAT_MODE_COUNT 8 at include/iosupport.h:106; argv[32] at sysneutrino.cpp:1184, argvMax = 32 at 1190. Counted every argv[argc++] before 1370: 1196, 1201, 1204, 1207 (apa) or 1211, 1232, 1247, 1277, then 1287, 1295, 1299, 1318, 1330, 1342 (x2), 1359 = 13 at most.

findings.title: Stale, doubled and misplaced comments in sysneutrino.cpp, sysdisc.cpp and system.h
findings.problem: sysneutrino.cpp:190-192 and 193-198 are two versions of the same comment on neutrinoArgHasActiveFlag. 263-268 (describes the old sysLaunchNeutrino body) and 269-278 (describes sysSyncNeutrinoUdpfsToml at 382) sit above sysLastPathSeparator. 1186-1189 says the limit is '14, NOT sizeof(argv)' directly above argvMax = sizeof(argv)/sizeof(argv[0]) = 32. 1363-1365 is a placeholder saying nothing happens here. sysdisc.cpp:109-117 documents sysLaunchDisc/sysGetDiscBootPath but sits above sysDiscProbeWait. system.h:81-82 describe sysNeutrinoArgsPreflight (line 96) but sit above the cheats comment.
findings.fix: Delete 190-192, 263-268, 1363-1365 and the wrong first sentence of 1186-1189; move 269-278 above sysSyncNeutrinoUdpfsToml, sysdisc.cpp:109-117 above sysGetDiscBootPath, and system.h:81-82 above line 96.
findings.benefit: About 12 lines removed and comments that match the code; no binary change.
findings.evidence: Read each cited range against the code below it: sysLastPathSeparator at 279, sysSyncNeutrinoUdpfsToml at 382, argvMax at 1190 with argv[32] at 1184, sysDiscProbeWait at sysdisc.cpp:121, sysGetDiscBootPath at 147, sysNeutrinoArgsPreflight prototype at system.h:96.
